name: Ellucian Foundation PATH Grant (JCU)
summary: A $1,500 grant for full-time JCU bachelor students at risk of dropping out after recent financial hardship.
who: Enrolled full-time in a bachelor-level degree and in good academic standing.
At risk of withdrawing due to financial need after recent hardship, such as loss of income, a family crisis or a natural disaster.
Must consent to application data being shared with the Ellucian Foundation.
how: Apply online through the JCU scholarships page.
catches: Applications close at midday on 30 October 2026.
Paid as a one-off lump sum once accepted.
